title: Clifford semigroups and the monoidal Grothendieck construction
summary: We show that the monoidal Grothendieck construction can be applied to recover the known structure theorem for Clifford monoids, which states that they correspond to functors from a semilattice into the category of groups. Furthermore, we capture the category of Clifford monoids itself as a Grothendieck construction of the functor sending a semilattice L to the functor category [L, Grp] and use this to construct a number of factorisation systems on this category.
